About Dragonfly
 Dragonfly is a global, crypto-native investment firm. We're a team of seasoned VCs and technologists investing in generational companies and protocols, with deep roots in New York, Silicon Valley, and Asia. Our team is both highly technical and has deep expertise in financial markets. We have published some of the most widely read research on stablecoins, market structure, decentralized finance, and protocol security. Our AUM is over $3.6B, and we're one of the fastest-growing firms in the crypto industry.
 Overview
 You'll be joining a small team and working directly with our Managing and General Partners, portfolio companies, and investors. These include many of the biggest crypto companies and protocols, world-renowned PE and VC investors, and founders of large public tech and finance companies. You'll be part of a highly collaborative global team of partners, with an exclusive focus on mid-stage venture capital and growth equity.
 You should be passionate about crypto, fintech, and technology while being comfortable with flexible and entrepreneurial work environments, and looking to rapidly accelerate your career in investing.
 Functional Responsibilities
 • Proactively source and field new investment opportunities
• Conduct relevant business and financial analysis, valuation, modeling, deal structuring and due diligence support
• Conduct and discuss relevant industry and market research and analysis
• Provide high-touch support to portfolio companies post-investment
• Opportunity for research, publishing, and media
 Requirements
 • 4+ years of experience in Private Equity, Growth Equity, VC, Investment Management, Consulting, and/or Investment Banking
• Strong analytical skills with an aptitude for slicing and dicing data, and an ability to think critically about how things work on the ground
• Some expertise in one or more of the following areas relevant to crypto: Math, Cryptography, Finance, Econ, CS, Engineering, Philosophy, Social Sciences
• Exceptional communication, interpersonal, pattern recognition, and project management skills, with equally exceptional work ethic
• Self-accountability and the ability to work autonomously in a fast-moving environment
• Ability to work full-time from our New York office
• Ability to interact across cultures and businesses
• Passion for blockchain, fintech and technology
 Strong ethical code
 Preferred
 • Prior investment experience in crypto companies, fintech, or tech
• High (but open-minded and flexible) conviction around your own ideas
• Familiarity with relevant crypto tools and forums (e.g., know your way around Crypto Twitter, Dune Analytics, navigating Etherscan contracts)
• Intrinsically motivated to learn about all forms of relevant data
• Strong network within fintech, technology and crypto
 Benefits
 • Highly competitive salary and carry (commensurate to experience; not bound by listed range)
 Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance
 Annual phone plan reimbursement
 Laptop and equipment provided
 • Unlimited vacation: Take time when you need it (and we really mean it)
• Annual in-person offsite in unique locations around the globe
• Ability to personally invest in our venture and/or liquid funds without fees
 Note: The general salary range for this role is $300k-450k, although we will pay commensurate to experience.
